s004: These terms set the conditions for using ShareRun (the "Service"), provided by 하상기 (the "Operator"). By using the Service you agree to these terms and to the Privacy Policy. The Privacy Policy governs how personal information is collected and used; these terms govern your use of the Service.
s006: ShareRun is an app for recording walks and runs, joining challenges and tournaments, and earning and sharing virtual currency based on your activity. The Operator provides record verification, rankings, rewards, donation information and notifications. Some features may be in preparation or unavailable in certain versions. Paid DIA is sold through Google Play Billing. Until the Operator opens in-app purchases, the purchase screen stays closed and no charge is made during that time. Apple in-app purchase may be opened later.
s008: You sign up with a method the Operator has opened: Google, Kakao or Naver. Anyone under 14 years of age cannot sign up.
s009: You can link additional sign-in methods to one account. Once linked, any of the methods opens the same account.
s010: Another sign-in method is not linked to an empty account that has no nickname. Before linking, the Operator shows only the nickname and SHARE balance of the target account and asks for your confirmation.
s011: You can unlink sign-in methods except the last one. Unlinking the last method is not allowed because you could no longer get back into the account.
s012: Identity verification and the currency ledger of an account are based on the records on the Operator's servers. Values that exist only on your phone are not the reference.
s014: SHARE, DIA and VALUE are virtual currencies used only within the Service. They have no cash value and cannot be transferred, sold or inherited between users.
s015: The ledger on the Operator's servers is the only reference for balances and changes. The numbers shown in the app display that ledger.
s016: If misuse, an error or a violation of these terms is confirmed, the Operator may withhold the currency concerned or take back currency already granted.
s017: When you delete your account, the remaining currency expires. It is not exchanged for cash or refunded.
s018: Payment, granting, withdrawal and refunds for DIA you paid for follow "4. Paid DIA purchases and withdrawal" below. If that section differs from this one, that section prevails. While the purchase screen is closed, no charge has been made, so there is no cash refund.
s020: Rewards and rankings are limited to records you walked or ran yourself. Bicycles, scooters, vehicles, using someone else's records, location spoofing, automation and abuse through multiple accounts are prohibited.
s021: The Operator verifies records using distance, time, route, steps, movement, device integrity and similar signals. Records that do not meet the criteria are not recognized.
s022: If a fraudulent record is confirmed, no reward is granted for it, and the SHARE, DIA and VALUE already granted, as well as ranking and prize eligibility, may be forfeited or cancelled.
s023: Repeated or serious misuse may lead to your account being suspended or deleted.
s024: If you believe a record was wrongly rejected, you can ask for an explanation through the in-app appeal screen or the email address below.
s026: Tournament prizes and rewards are either in-Service currency or in-kind items or donations within a scope announced in advance by the Operator. Conversion into cash prizes is not promised.
s027: Sponsorship and donation mean using currency in the Service for a purpose you choose there (such as prize funds or donations). The Operator does not collect cash fundraising that it has not announced.
s028: Where details of a donation being carried out are announced, they are provided to the extent the Operator has confirmed. A third party's sponsorship offer is not a promise of the Service until the Operator has confirmed it.
s030: You keep the rights to content you post, such as your nickname, introduction, appeal text and photos. You allow the Operator to store and display that content to the extent needed to run the Service, handle reports and prevent misuse.
s031: You may not post content that infringes others' rights, or that is hateful, obscene, fraudulent, exposes personal information, or disrupts the operation of the Service.
s032: Other users can report a problem through the in-app report function or the email address below. After review, the Operator may hide the content or restrict the account.
s034: If there is a violation of these terms, misuse, harm to other users or a violation of law, the Operator may issue a warning, restrict features, suspend temporarily or suspend permanently. Unless urgent action is needed, the reason is given through an in-app notice or email. You can raise an objection at the email address below.
s036: You can request deletion at any time through the in-app account deletion or the method in the account deletion guide. When you delete, your sign-in methods are cut off, the remaining SHARE, DIA and VALUE expire, and your data is handled under the retention and destruction rules in the Privacy Policy. Records that must be kept by law are kept separately for that period.
s038: Numbers shown by the Service, such as steps, distance and heart rate, are for exercise reference only. They are not medical practice, diagnosis, treatment or health advice. If you are concerned about your condition, consult a medical professional.
s039: You are responsible for injury, accidents and illness during exercise. Set the intensity to suit your condition.
s040: Records may be missing or delayed because of failures in device sensors, Health Connect, communication networks or third-party sign-in (Google, Kakao, Naver). The Operator does not guarantee those external services.
s041: The Operator is not liable if it cannot provide the Service for reasons it cannot reasonably control, such as natural disasters, war, power outages or failures of telecommunications carriers.
s043: To the extent permitted by law, the Operator is not liable for indirect damages, special damages or loss of expected profit arising from use of the Service. While there are no paid DIA purchases, the Operator's liability for damages to a user does not exceed ordinary damages unless the Operator acted intentionally or with gross negligence. Liability related to paid DIA purchases takes priority to the extent provided by the Act on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce and other applicable consumer laws.
s045: The Operator may change these terms when the Service or the law changes. Changes are announced, for example by an in-app notice, 7 days before they take effect. Changes that are unfavorable to users are announced 30 days before. If you keep using the Service after a change, you are regarded as having agreed to the changed terms. If you do not agree, you can stop using the Service and delete your account.
s047: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea. Disputes arising from use of the Service fall under the jurisdiction of the court determined by the Civil Procedure Act and other applicable laws.

s053: DIA bought this way is virtual currency used only inside the Service. It cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred or sold between users, and it is not used for donations. Donations are made by the Operator from its own funds. The Battle Run pass and Pass+ can be bought only with paid DIA. Cosmetic items such as skins and accessories, and the other items the app presents (record protection, entry, tournament deposits, crews, nickname changes and similar), spend free DIA first and paid DIA only if free DIA is not enough. Items that accept only free DIA cannot be bought with paid DIA.
s054: Paid DIA (the pack's base amount) and bonus DIA are granted only after Google Play confirms that the purchase is complete. A purchase token is identified only by its hash, and the same receipt grants DIA only once. Sending it again from the same account does not grant more, and a receipt that belongs to another account is not granted.
s055: You can request withdrawal of that purchase in the app within 7 days from the time the server recorded the purchase (withdrawal under the Act on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce: only the unused portion, and the portion already used is excluded). Each purchase can be withdrawn only once. The paid DIA returned is the lesser of that pack's paid amount and the paid DIA still in the wallet then. If no paid DIA remains, or the calculated refund is 0 KRW or less, it cannot be withdrawn. 1 paid DIA is 100 KRW. Bonus DIA granted with the pack is taken back in proportion to the paid DIA returned. If that bonus was already spent, 100 KRW per spent bonus DIA is deducted from the refund. When a withdrawal is accepted, the DIA to be taken back is removed at once, and the money is returned as a Google Play refund. If the Google Play refund does not go through at once, the request stays accepted and the Operator handles it.
s056: You can also get the money back through a Google Play order refund. When Google Play refunds a purchase or reverses the payment (a chargeback), the server checks it and takes back the paid DIA from that pack still left in the wallet, and the matching bonus DIA. Paid DIA already spent does not take the wallet below 0, and the amount that could not be taken back is recorded as a shortfall. A purchase already withdrawn in the app is not debited again. The same voided purchase is handled only once.
s057: A paid purchase made by a minor without the consent of their legal guardian can be cancelled under the Civil Act. The minor or the legal guardian can request cancellation at the email at the end of these terms.
s052: The products for sale are consumable DIA packs through Google Play Billing. dia_pack_12 1,200 (DIA 12), dia_pack_60 5,900 (DIA 59, bonus DIA 1), dia_pack_130 12,000 (DIA 120, bonus DIA 10), dia_pack_370 33,000 (DIA 330, bonus DIA 40), dia_pack_700 59,000 (DIA 590, bonus DIA 110), dia_pack_1500 119,000 (DIA 1190, bonus DIA 310).
